values.value: How many HubSpot portals do you run, and are they split into business units inside one account?
How many separate tenancies or brand containers there are

[{"value":1,"label":"One portal, with no business units."},{"value":2,"label":"Two to five portals or business units, sharing some content and property definitions."},{"value":3,"label":"Six or more portals or business units, or brands that share content and audiences across several of them."}]
Business units are an Enterprise feature, so if you have never seen the setting, the answer is almost certainly one portal.

reference/ma-migrator-capabilities/platforms/hubspot.yaml — the tenancy nouns the object catalogue and infrastructure.tier_gating use (portals, and Enterprise-only business units), replacing the base wording's "child accounts", which is not a HubSpot construct at all. LAYER 1: the bands are untouched (one / two to five / six or more) because the thing being counted is the same thing — separate brand containers, each of which becomes its own destination business unit and its own adapter run per docs/specs/tier-2/sfmc-target-adapter.md §7.1. This is the one complexity dimension with no readiness slot beside it, so there was nothing to disentangle; it needed HubSpot's vocabulary and nothing more. Distinct from the target_bu_structure supplement in instrument/migration-accelerator/supplements/sfmc_classic_readiness.yaml, which asks the opposite question about the DESTINATION tenant.
